items.headline: Heat Advisory issued July 19 at 12:23PM AKDT until July 20 at 7:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to around 80 expected.

* WHERE...City of Hyder.

* WHEN...From 1 PM to 7 PM AKDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Individuals not accustomed to these unusually hot
temperatures for this region may experience heat related illnesses.
items.instruction:
Take extra precautions when outside. Wear sunscreen and light loose
fitting clothing. Take action when you see symptoms of heat
exhaustion and heat stroke.

Locations next to the ocean or glaciers will be cooler with a
stronger breeze in the afternoon.

items.headline: Flood Warning issued July 19 at 11:09AM AKDT until July 21 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Seward.

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is expected.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1042 AM AKDT, moderate rain is falling in Seward and
vicinity causing water levels along local rivers and streams
to begin to rise. Rainfall will become heavy at times this
afternoon and continue through tonight before rain lightens
up on Monda
items.instruction:
Stay tuned to further developments by listening to your local radio,

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 19 at 10:47AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued July 19 at 8:13AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
ESFAFC

Local reports and river gage data indicate a glacier dammed lake
release on the Kennicott River near McCarthy.  Water levels on the
Kennicott are currently rising and will continue to rise over the
next 24-48 hours, cresting at or prior to Monday evening.

At this time, the river is expected to crest below minor flood
stage.  Widespread flooding is not anticipated, although the
following hazards will be present:

-Significant water level rises (feet/day)
-Bank erosion: Fast moving water

items.description:

* WHERE...Seward.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- A long duration rain event coinciding with an atmospheric
river of moisture moving over the southern Kenai Peninsula
will result in moderate to heavy rain for Seward Saturday
eve
items.instruction:

television, or NOAA Weather Radio

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued July 18 at 4:57PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
An atmospheric river of moisture will bring periods of moderate
to heavy rain and gusty southeasterly winds through Turnagain Arm
and across portions of the eastern Kenai Peninsula. The heaviest
rain and strongest winds will likely occur between late tonight
and Monday evening.

Likely (70-80%) rainfall amounts and wind gusts:

For Whittier: 3 to 5 inches of rain; wind gusts up to 35 mph.

For Portage: 2 to 4 inches of rain; wind gusts up to 55 mph.

For Girdwood: 1 to 2 inches of rain; wind gus
items.areas: East Turnagain Arm; Portage; Skilak Lake; Interior Kenai Peninsula; Turnagain Pass; West Prince William Sound & Whittier
